crossRefs.note: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal…
In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

translations.web: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.
translations.kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
translations.asv: And he goeth up into the mountain, and calleth unto him whom he himself would; and they went unto him.
